name: GET /api/leadflow/saved-views - the views this caller may see
description: Views visible to the caller: their own private ones plus everything shared at team or organization scope. Scoping is applied in the QUERY rather than filtered after the fact, so a private view belonging to somebody else never travels over the wire in the first place. QA: reads the view created earlier in the chain.

testCases.name: Only the caller's own private views and shared ones are returned
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
